trap.label: zero: when/if
trap.wrong: When I am hungry I will eat.
trap.why: Em português 'quando eu estiver com fome, comerei' usa futuro; no zero conditional é presente + presente (fatos gerais).

mcq.q: When it's cold, I ___ a coat.

opts: If I eat late, I feel sick.
If I ate late, I feel sick.
If I will eat late, I feel sick.

fix.wrong: When I will wake up, I drink water.
fix.right: When I wake up, I drink water.

fix.wrong: When it rains, I stayed home.
fix.right: When it rains, I stay home.

rewrite.prompt: Una com when: “It's cold. I wear a coat.”
rewrite.answer: When it's cold, I wear a coat.

rewrite.prompt: Inverta: “I wear a coat if it's cold.”
rewrite.answer: If it's cold, I wear a coat.

rewrite.prompt: Negativa: “If you eat, you get sick.” (não come)
rewrite.answer: If you don't eat, you get sick.
